turns.question: What are experience points?
turns.text: Not in this guide — from outside research: Per the original rule book, the hero earns experience for solving puzzles, achieving goals and killing monsters, and gains hit points automatically at each new level. Experience needed: level 2 at 2,000; level 3 at 4,000; level 4 at 8,000; level 5 at 16,000; level 6 at 32,000; level 7 at 64,000; level 8 at 125,000; level 9 at 250,000. The hero starts as a second-level corsair, and View Stats in the menu shows the current experience total.

turns.question: What are hit points?
turns.text: Not in this guide — from outside research: In the original rule book, hit points are shown by the red health bar at the top of the screen; at zero the hero dies and you must start a new game or load a saved one. Health comes back by drinking a healing potion or visiting places where healing is available, and the maximum only goes up by gaining a level. View Stats in the menu shows the numeric maximum.
